indication: EGFRvIII+ glioblastoma (Cohort 1 newly diagnosed unmethylated MGMT; Cohort 2 recurrent)

inclusion_match_notes: Eligibility is conditional on TWO unresolved diagnostic gates: EGFRvIII positivity (currently unknown) and unmethylated MGMT (currently unknown) for Cohort 1. If both confirm positive, this is one of the highest-fit cellular-therapy trials available to a newly-diagnosed GBM patient. The synNotch design narrows on-target/off-tumor toxicity vs. earlier first-generation CART-EGFRvIII. Carry the intratumoral-hemorrhage history forward — CRS/ICANS and intracranial edema are foreseeable and the screening team will want clear baseline imaging.
intervention_dosing: Lymphodepleting cyclophosphamide + fludarabine days -5 to -3; E-SYNC infusion day 0 at 5e7 (DL1) or 1.5e8 (DL2) CAR+ cells.

biomarker: EGFR amplification (no vIII requirement); IL13Ra2 is the second CAR target but not gating for tumor selection

Builds on the Bagley/O'Rourke Penn EGFRvIII platform that produced the NEJM 2024 cellular-therapy signals; the dual-target design is the lab's response to single-antigen escape.
intervention_dosing: Three arms: single fixed-dose post-lymphodepletion, repeat doses post-lymphodepletion, single pre-op fixed-dose.

inclusion_match_notes: Cross-context evidence: published NEJM 2024 first-in-human results from the Choi/Maus MGH program — the foundational paper for the CAR-T + TEAM-engager combination class. journal: ClinicalTrials.gov record (Global Coalition for Adaptive Research)

biomarker: Subsequently shown to be MGMT-methylation-driven for the largest benefit
intervention: RT 60 Gy + concurrent TMZ 75 mg/m2/day x 6 weeks, then 6 cycles adjuvant TMZ 150-200 mg/m2 days 1-5 q28d

indication: Newly diagnosed glioblastoma after Stupp RT+TMZ
inclusion_match_notes: EF-14 supports adding TTFields to maintenance TMZ in newly diagnosed GBM regardless of MGMT. Patient is ECOG 1 post-subtotal resection, which fits the EF-14 population. Device is commercially available (Optune); no trial enrollment required. Wear-time compliance ≥18 hr/day is the practical commitment. The follow-on TRIDENT (NCT04471844, EF-32) tested concomitant TTFields during RT and completed February 2026 — TTFields-during-RT is the next maturation step but the EF-14 add-on-during-maintenance is the current standard.
intervention_dosing: Optune transducer arrays continuously, target ≥18 hr/day, started with adjuvant TMZ cycle 1.

biomarker: Both MGMT-methylated and unmethylated enrolled (stratification at randomization)
intervention: Optune (TTFields 200 kHz) concomitant with RT + TMZ, then continued with maintenance TMZ
comparator: Standard RT + TMZ, then Optune added at maintenance only (EF-14 control)
inclusion_match_notes: TRIDENT completed enrollment February 2026 and is no longer recruiting; primary results expected later in 2026-2027. Kept as pipeline-context: this is the trial that will determine whether TTFields-during-RT (in addition to during-maintenance) adds incremental OS benefit. If positive, the standard of care shifts to TTFields-from-RT-day-1, which the patient should know about even if they cannot enroll.
intervention_dosing: Optune from day 1 of RT through second progression; TMZ standard schedule.

inclusion_match_notes: Eligible only if MGMT methylation testing returns METHYLATED. The CeTeG/NOA-09 regimen layers lomustine onto Stupp and the OS signal is the largest published in any newly-diagnosed MGMT-methylated GBM trial — open-label design and small sample size (n=141) are the caveats. The hematologic toxicity (cumulative CCNU myelosuppression) is the practical limiter; absolute counts and frailty assessment matter at age 66. Decision-relevant if MGMT is methylated; not applicable if unmethylated.
intervention_dosing: Lomustine 100 mg/m2 day 1 + TMZ 100-200 mg/m2 days 2-6 every 6 weeks for up to 6 cycles, with concurrent RT (60 Gy).

indication: Newly diagnosed glioblastoma in patients age ≥65

intervention: Hypofractionated RT 40 Gy/15 fx + concurrent and adjuvant TMZ
inclusion_match_notes: Patient is 66 — meets the age inclusion. Hypofractionated RT + TMZ is the elderly-GBM standard when full 6-week Stupp RT is unacceptable for fitness reasons; at ECOG 1 the patient could tolerate full-course Stupp, so this is the alternative if performance status declines or geography/access constraints argue for a shorter RT course. MGMT-methylated patients derive the largest OS benefit (HR 0.53); unmethylated patients still benefit but less. Practical and relevant to the older-adult discussion.
intervention_dosing: RT 40 Gy in 15 fractions over 3 weeks + TMZ 75 mg/m2 daily during RT + 12 cycles adjuvant TMZ 150-200 mg/m2 days 1-5 q28d.

inclusion_match_notes: Tumor-agnostic basket: eligible IF the patient's BRAF V600E testing returns positive. BRAF V600E is rare in adult IDHwt GBM (~1-2%), so the prior probability is low, but the test is on the comprehensive-NGS panel that is already being ordered. If positive, the dabrafenib + trametinib tumor-agnostic FDA label applies (no satisfactory alternatives in HGG when prior SOC exhausted). Conditional row — confirmation of biomarker is a hard gate.
intervention_dosing: Dabrafenib 150 mg PO BID + trametinib 2 mg PO daily.

effect_size: ORR 75% (independent review) / 80% (investigator); CNS responses observed in subsequent expansion (Doz 2022)
inclusion_match_notes: Tumor-agnostic FDA-approved indication: eligible IF NTRK fusion is detected on the RNA-fusion panel (Tempus xR or Caris WTS are the most sensitive). NTRK fusions are vanishingly rare in adult IDHwt GBM (<1%), so the conditional gate is the rate-limiting step. CNS responses confirmed in Doz et al. 2022 (PMID 34850167) including pediatric and adult HGG, which strengthens the CNS-specific evidence — important since DNA-only NGS panels miss intron-deep breakpoints in CNS tumors. Order RNA-fusion alongside the comprehensive panel.
intervention_dosing: Larotrectinib 100 mg PO BID (adult).

inclusion_match_notes: Tumor-agnostic pembrolizumab opens IF TMB-H or MSI-H or dMMR returns positive on the comprehensive NGS / IHC panel. Primary MMR-deficient GBM is uncommon; hypermutation in GBM is more often acquired post-TMZ (so this row is more relevant at recurrence than at diagnosis). FoundationOne CDx is the FDA-approved companion DX for the TMB-H label. Conditional row gated on the molecular result.
intervention_dosing: Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV q3w or 400 mg q6w.

Northwest Biotherapeutics is the access pathway. Surfaced because the user asked for compassionate-use / expanded-access options.

Surfaced directly because the user asked for compassionate-use options.

ACTIVE NOT RECRUITING as of latest verification; re-screen for site reopenings.
